lines: Andrew Richard Woglom, Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 256,630 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹3.88 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares face a 6 months lock-in from allotment, so a later conversation on remaining holdings could follow.
Retained holding is unknown: the pre-offer holding is not confirmed from the documents.
